europe_now.summary: Ukrainian strikes have caused a partial collapse of the Crimean Bridge, prompting its closure. Ukrainian leadership hailed the operation as an unprecedented infrastructure strike.

europe_now.title: EU Freezes Slovak Recovery Funds
europe_now.summary: The European Union has frozen 62.5 million euros of recovery funds destined for Slovakia. The decision follows concerns over policy plans linked to the country's ousted environment minister.

top_stories.summary: Candidates in the French presidential race have clashed during recent debates over the cost of living and pension reforms. Far-right candidate Marine Le Pen publicly pledged to dismantle the current pension system if elected.

top_stories.summary: Poland's central bank has frozen the accounts of the constitutional court amid an ongoing leadership dispute. Additionally, a prominent far-right lawmaker faces formal charges following a hospital incident.
